name: Elena: Crimson Archives
source:
11:42 PM, St. Jude's College, Department of Palaeography. An after-hours alarm sounds from the sealed Blackwood Archive. The protagonist has faculty keys; inside is Elena, a twenty-two year old research assistant halfway through photographing a ledger that is not supposed to exist. She did not break in — the timed lock came down while she was copying the page that carries her own family name.

The first hour's choices open one of three routes — Interrogation, Fall or Pact — which diverge after the confrontation and each reach their own ending. Five chapters, three endings, six event CGs.

[From [url=https://roomnotfound.itch.io/elena-crimson-archives]the itch.io page[/url]]
translation:
深夜11点42分，圣裘德学院古文书学系。下班闭馆后的警报声从封存的布莱克伍德档案馆中骤然响起。手握教职员钥匙的主人公推门而入，发现22岁的研究助理埃琳娜正拍到一本本不该存在于世的账册的一半。她并非破门闯入——就在她誊拍载有自己家族姓氏的那一页时，定时门锁恰好落下将她困在了里面。

前一小时内的抉择将开启三条路线之一——“审讯”、“沉沦”或“契约”——剧情将在当面对质后分道扬镳，各自通向截然不同的结局。全作共五章、三个结局、六张事件CG。

[摘自[url=https://roomnotfound.itch.io/elena-crimson-archives]itch.io页面[/url]]
